designDecisionsAndRationale: BPMN elements are first-class registry types with semantic payloads (not styled shapes), so AI tools can read and diff semantics separately from visual data (design 3.2).
Waypoint-basis math moves from core connector.ts into @nodetto/ir, because @nodetto/io needs it and cannot import @nodetto/core (design 5.2).
One renderer-neutral notation module feeds both the SVG export and the ui-solid views, so canvas and export cannot diverge and tests can count roles. MarkerKind is unchanged (design 6.1, 6.2).
Connection legality lives in Editor intent methods, so imports, undo, clipboard and collab keep accepting stored documents (design 4.3).
A hand-written, non-validating XML parser with a deterministic serializer that rejects DOCTYPE; no dependency (design 5.1, 14).
The export route resolver is injected through options.routeOf, so io does not depend on core (design 5.3).
Lint rule semantics are ported from the bpmnlint documentation and pinned by tests; messages use nodetto's own wording (design 7.3, 13).
Cross-package fixture acceptance tests live in @nodetto/core, because only core dev-depends on @nodetto/io (bpmn-13).
Test ownership (design 11.1 rules 1-2): every plan owns a focused bun test; pinned-list tests have exactly one owner.

Parallel-wave gate (design 11.1 rule 3): owner-scoped implementation gates keep sibling in-progress files from blocking a finished plan (the s357 bpmn-07 case). Whole-repo gates move to reconciliation and final verification, where ownership routing is serial.
User-QA defaults: lane delete cascades (Q1), desktop lint always uses recommended (Q2), SCHEMA_VERSION stays 1 with no migration (Q3).
intentionalTradeoffs: Deleting a lane deletes its member nodes (cascade), unlike bpmn-js; undo restores them.
BPMNDI ids (<id>_di) and edge docking points are regenerated on export; semantic ids, shape/label bounds and interior waypoints are preserved.
Older builds reject documents containing a bpmn page with a value.enum error.
Under the parallel-wave gate a plan can finish while sibling-owned files still fail typecheck; whole-repo gates catch this at the wave join.
packages/core/src/bpmn/index.ts and packages/core/src/shapes/connector.ts are committed in the pre-fanout commit with wave-2 lines already present.
supportedEdgeCases: Nested lanes, collapsed black-box pools, expanded and collapsed sub-processes, boundary events (interrupting and non-interrupting).
Message flow inside one pool, sequence flow across pools, incoming flow to a start event and outgoing flow from an end event are rejected or corrected at edit time but accepted on import/undo/collab.
Unsupported BPMN constructs and foreign XML extension content preserved with import warnings, never silently dropped; DOCTYPE and malformed XML rejected with a parse error.
Reference-file tests skip when .reference is absent (CI) and run locally.
Imported .bpmn in the desktop stays detached (filePath null) so autosave never overwrites the source file.
Pool move translates lanes and contents; lane resize restacks siblings with one undo step.
A finished wave plan whose own G1/G2 gates are clean is not blocked by typecheck diagnostics or test failures located only in sibling-owned in-progress files (design 11.1 rule 3).
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Lane deletion that re-parents nodes instead of cascading
Per-document or desktop lint configuration; plugin:* extends (config error)
A pool placed over existing tasks uses generic nextIndex placement
